visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length black hair and a red tank top stands in a brightly lit hotel room. She smiles and waves both hands toward the camera. The background shows a white bed and a dark wooden door. (2) She holds up a clear bottle with a gold cap and sprays a mist over her face and hair. Her expression is calm as she closes her eyes to receive the spray. (3) She opens a small red bottle and uses a dropper to apply serum directly onto her forehead and cheeks. She then uses her fingertips to gently pat and spread the product across her face. (4) Holding a round jar, she takes a small amount of cream on her finger and dabs it onto her forehead, cheeks, and chin before massaging it in with upward strokes. (5) She continues to massage her face with both hands, looking into the camera with a slight smile, highlighting her glowing skin. (6) She tosses her hair back and begins applying foundation using a blue puff, dabbing it evenly across her face. (7) She holds an eyebrow pencil and carefully fills in her eyebrows while looking intently at her reflection. (8) She presents a black Chanel eyeliner pencil to the camera and applies it to her lower lash line. (9) She uses a makeup brush to apply light-colored eyeshadow to her lids, followed by showing a black cream blush pot which she applies to her cheeks. (10) She holds up a gold lipstick tube, shows the red color, and applies it to her lips. She follows this with a lip balm from a frosted tube. (11) She fixes her hair and sprays perfume on her neck. She then steps back to show her full outfit: the red tank top paired with a plaid shirt tied around her waist and brown cowboy boots. (12) A close-up montage of Chanel makeup products appears on a beige leather-textured surface. (13) She stands in the center of the hotel room, twirling and posing to show the final look.
